subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw add a portable message-tool multi-select contract in core/SDK, or keep batch selection as plugin/channel-specific UI built on existing hooks?
rationale: The requested behavior crosses public message presentation, plugin SDK, and channel transport boundaries, so the permanent contract shape needs maintainer product/API direction.

options.title: Add portable multi-select contract
options.body: Design an additive SDK/message presentation block with channel-specific renderers and one structured selected-values callback.

options.title: Keep it plugin-owned
options.body: Use existing plugin hooks to build workflow-specific selection UIs without adding a new cross-platform core contract.

recommendation.title: Add portable multi-select contract
recommendation.body: Design an additive SDK/message presentation block with channel-specific renderers and one structured selected-values callback.

likelyOwner.reason: The current shared presentation and SDK contract lines route most directly through steipete's recent history on the affected files.
